page.layout: One column of running text, with a few small marginal notes in the left margin, one of them "Saturnus." beside the last paragraph. Running head at top right. Catchword and signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: Invisibilis est vel κρύψις vel σύνοδος@[?].
Κρύψις est Lunæ sub radiis solaribus recta occultatio.
Σύνοδος cum Luna centro Solis recta est subjecta.
Visibilis apparet vel non plena, vel plena.
Non plena est Crescens vel Decrescēs.
Decrescens, quæ minuitur. Utraq; est vel Falcata, vel διχότομος, vel ἀμφίκυρος.
Falcata, cum primum e radiis Solis emergere apparet.
Διχότομος est, cum per medium quasi dissecta quadrante circuli à Sole distat.
Ἀμφίκυρος[?] est, cum à Sole quatuor signis distat.
Plena Lunæ figura est πανσέληνος[?], cum Soli diametraliter oppositā totam medietatem irradiatam terræ ostentat.
Secundi generis Planetæ sunt vel Heterodromi, vel Homodromi.
Heterodromi sunt, qui diverso motu, impariq; tempore, sua conficiunt spatia, Ut sunt.
I. Saturnus omnium supremus, 30. annis periodum suam absolvens.Saturnus.

page.notes: Faint, bleed-through text in the left margin and at the right edge of the page is illegible and not transcribed; it is show-through from the facing page. The Greek sign after "Invisibilis" and after "Σύνοδος" and "Διχότομος" (the astronomical symbols) and the Greek word forms Ἀμφίκυρος and πανσέληνος are doubtful and marked [?]. The catchword and signature are read from the foot right corner.
